rules: Every number carries the results-log row (r_id) it was checked against; R84 corrections applied.
AI $ is a list-price estimate (list price per call), not a provider bill.
Tabular races (R82, R75, R38) use simulated GPU time: their GPU $ is simulated.
Every number has in_log = true; the build refuses unlogged numbers (dashboard_spec.md section 6).
Every card has a worse_side: show it on the same screen as the card.
Card 'vs_no_ai_tool' is for a second slide or Q&A, not the main screen (D46).

metrics.note: Goal: a score of −170, frozen before the races. It is an easy goal with 30 machines: the no-AI tuning tool also reaches it in the first minute (R78, R48)

metrics.label: Cost to reach the goal

metrics.note: Goal: a score of −170, frozen before the races. It is an easy goal with 30 machines: the no-AI tuning tool also reaches it in the first minute (R78, R48)

metrics.note: Why it works: the standard assistant leaves machines idle while it thinks

metrics.hover: Experiments finished ÷ total cost, per race

comparison.formula: Busy Machines mean ÷ standard mean (experiments per $)

metrics.label: Fake improvements accepted
metrics.hover: Attempts that tested on data they had already seen (a shortcut that fakes a better score) and were accepted as a new best. Busy Machines' built-in tuner tried the shortcut 847 times; the checker accepted none

worse_side.caption: In 1 of 3 races a burst of fake-checking calls took the AI bill to 0.34× the standard assistant's (still cheaper). Busy Machines matched the standard assistant's best model in 2 of 3 races.

items.text: Race 3: the built-in tuner found the shortcut 759 times; the checker caught every one, but the extra checks raised the AI bill to 0.34× the standard assistant's (other races 0.21×)
Matching the standard assistant's best model: 2 of 3 races; in race 2 Busy Machines ended 0.19 short (the standard assistant's model was better there)
The no-AI tuning tool costs less still ($0.35 per race) and reaches the easy goal for $0.009 in 0.4 min, but builds a worse model (−157.3) and shipped a fake in 3 of 3 races
